recipes.title: 18 s shot-by-shot brand film
recipes.summary: One hero object threads every shot; exact copy, a cue every 0.6–0.9 s; outgoing text leaves before incoming arrives.
recipes.body:
Write every shot with exact copy and a cue time. One hero object (the product's icon, a card, a shape) carries
through all shots and changes role. No bounce, no particles. Ends on the hero object becoming the logo.

recipes.title: 8-page LinkedIn carousel
recipes.summary: Hook page in the ICP's words, six one-idea pages from validated pains, a CTA page. 1080×1350 PDF.
recipes.body:
Page 1: the pain as a question, in the ICP's words. Pages 2–7: one idea each, from the strongest evidenced pains
or the founder's Story Bank (≤ 25 words a page). Page 8: what to do next + handle. Render with `studio still --pdf`.

recipes.title: 30 s changelog
recipes.summary: Three to five shipped changes, each a 5 s before/after on real UI, with a version stamp.
recipes.body:
Version stamp opens. 3–5 changes, ~5 s each: name of the change (≤ 5 words), before → after on real UI. Close on
"update now" + URL. Pull change names from the release notes the founder supplies.

recipes.title: 20 s data story
recipes.summary: One chart that changes the viewer's mind; build axes, reveal the line, annotate the turn. Real data only.
recipes.body:
Only real data (validation signals, the founder's metrics). Never rescale an axis to dramatize. Draw axes, reveal
the line on a spring, pause on the turning point with a 3–5 word annotation, end on what it means.

recipes.title: 3 min essay film
recipes.summary: A narrated argument with one recurring protagonist and a motif; chapters built by subagents; facts with sources.
recipes.body:
Treatment first with chapters. One recurring protagonist or object. ≤ 8 words on screen, held ≥ 2.5 s. Uncertain
facts go to `NOTES.md`, not the film. Use the multi-agent playbook: one scene-builder per chapter.

recipes.title: 30 s narrated explainer
recipes.summary: Problem, what it is, three steps, proof, name. Voiceover with cue words; captions as sidecar.
recipes.body:
| Time | Beat |
|---|---|
| 0–4 s | The pain, in the ICP's words (from `get_founder_context` evidence) |
| 4–9 s | What the product is, one sentence |
| 9–24 s | Three steps, ~5 s each, each with a visible result |
| 24–28 s | Proof: a real number or quote |
| 28–30 s | Name + URL |
~75 words of voiceover. Mark `{cue}` words for each visual hit.

recipes.title: 60 s kinetic type / lyric
recipes.summary: Word-synced type over a track; each section integrates text differently; per-word timing from captions.
recipes.body:
Run `studio beats` and `studio captions --text lyrics.txt`. Each section treats the words differently (stack, path,
mask, scale). The highlight never runs ahead of the voice. Big changes on bar lines.

recipes.title: 6 s logo sting
recipes.summary: The logo builds from a motif of the product in 4 s and holds 2 s; one sound.
recipes.body:
Build the logo from something the product does (a cursor stroke, a chart line, a card stack). Land on a downbeat
at 4 s, hold 2 s. One sound event plus a tail.

recipes.title: 20 s GitHub repo promo
recipes.summary: Terminal and code, install to first result in one take; stars and real usage only if true.
recipes.body:
Open on the result, then the install command typing in, then the first result, then one code snippet that shows
the API, then the repo URL. Use the README's own words. Star counts only if current and real.

recipes.title: 32 s classic SaaS launch
recipes.summary: Cards collapse into the logo, a cursor tours real screens, pull out to a feature grid, CTA. Widely copied, so make the hook yours.
recipes.body:
Hook (0–3 s) on the pain or result, not the logo. Tour 3 real screens (5–6 s each) with a cursor. Pull out to a
grid of 4–6 features (one read each, 1 s). CTA with URL. Because this shape is the most copied, the hook and one
unexpected transition must be specific to this founder.

Runnable: `studio init <name> --recipe saas-launch-32` creates this film from blocks; edit `film.json` scenes.

recipes.title: 15 s showreel
recipes.summary: Permission-framed energy piece; morphing product states on a ~120 BPM grid, logo on the last downbeat.
recipes.body:
Best for: brand energy, dev tools, a launch day post on X. Weak for explaining.

| Time | Shot | Read |
|---|---|---|
| 0–1 s | Open on the product doing its most impressive thing, mid-motion | "this is fast/smart" |
| 1–8 s | 4–6 morphing states of real UI, one per 2 beats; a command menu or cursor drives them | each state's result |
| 8–12 s | One metric card or before/after (real number only) | the proof |
| 12–15 s | Everything collapses into the logo on the downbeat; URL holds 1 s | the name |

Sound: a 120–124 BPM track, a hit on every state change, sub-bass under the logo.

recipes.title: 44 s emotional story
recipes.summary: A personal object, a montage, a payoff. B2C only; reads as parody for B2B.
recipes.body:
One emotional word drives it. Open on a personal object, montage of moments (one read each), a turn, the payoff
with the product as the enabler, not the hero. No narration; music carries it. Avoid for B2B.

recipes.title: 30 s one-shape UI loop
recipes.summary: One shape morphs through 8–12 UI states on a 120 BPM × 8-bar grid; never cuts; last frame equals first.
recipes.body:
List the states first (8–12): each is a UI moment (checkout, a toggle, a chart). One container shape morphs
between them, content enters after the container moves. Seamless: frame 0 equals the last frame, position and
velocity. `studio verify` runs the seam check. Great as a silent landing-page hero.

recipes.title: 15 s vertical feature
recipes.summary: 9:16 feature teaser for Reels/Shorts: hook word, the feature in action, result, name.
recipes.body:
0–1.5 s: a 2–3 word hook in the ICP's language. 1.5–10 s: the feature in action on a real screen, zoomed. 10–13 s:
the result. 13–15 s: name. Captions burned in; safe area respected.

Runnable: `studio init <name> --recipe vertical-feature-15` creates this film from blocks; edit `film.json` scenes.

styles.title: Dark keynote
styles.summary: Stage-lit product reveals on a near-black ground; one giant number, one accent, slow confident moves.
styles.best_for: launch films, metric reveals, dev tools

styles.title: Flat vector explainer
styles.summary: Simple shapes and characters explain how something works: problem, what, three steps, proof, name.
styles.best_for: explaining a new category to a new audience
styles.avoid_for: dev tools that want to look technical

styles.title: Ink and watercolour
styles.summary: Brush lines and washes that bloom and dry; calm, thoughtful, editorial.

styles.title: Living UI
styles.summary: The real product, moving: cursor tours, zooms into the action, one action every 3–4 s.

styles.title: Paper cut-out
styles.summary: Layered paper with real shadows and slight wobble; handmade and warm.
styles.best_for: founder stories, consumer products, brand films

styles.title: Risograph print
styles.summary: Two or three spot colours, halftone and slight misregistration; punchy, indie, print-shop.

styles.title: Swiss kinetic type
styles.summary: Grid-locked typography that moves on the beat; flat colour fields, hard cuts, no decoration.

styles.title: Vertical captions
styles.summary: 9:16 talking or voiceover reels where the words carry the film; 1–4 words per caption popping on the spoken word.
